title: SimParticles
description: Makes textures simpler while preserving the minecraft-style look
body:
This is **SimParticles**, a resource pack that rewamps and simplifies the textures of Minecraft while preserving the game's style.

**Why should i install it?**

If you want simple and good-looking textures for photos of homes and such things, this is for you!

A few things awaiting for you:

1. **Simpler Fire**: Fire particles, furnaces and torches all have a softer color and less colors in their fire.
   
2. **Music Note Particles**: Makes the music notes have the shape of a normal note and has less color.

If you want to help us make this resource pack here, you can submit ideas on our GitHub!
